hero.h1: Put {sym} in. Lock its value and get paid every day, or go 2x long. No liquidations.
hero.p: Everything is the {tok} token itself: you put it in, you take it out. Once a day, at the official close, the side that lost moves tokens to the side that won. Nobody borrows, so nobody gets liquidated.

rules.title: How it works
rules.1: Once a day. After the official {sym} close (Yahoo and Nasdaq must agree to the cent, and Chainlink's price on Base within 1 %), the close is proposed on-chain, can be disputed for 6 hours, then settles. Requests made before the bell are filled at that close; later ones at the next.
rules.2: Only the matched part moves. The smaller side is matched in full, the bigger side pro rata. The unmatched part of a deposit just holds the stock (1x), so your real leverage moves with the pool; it is always shown before you enter.
rules.3: Funding = 0.1 % a day × (long − short) ÷ (long + short), paid by the crowded side to the thin side, on the matched part only.
rules.4: No liquidations, no debt. One close beyond a tier's zero line takes that tier to zero, never below. Intraday prices never count.
rules.5: Everything compounds. Gains, losses and funding stay in your position. An entry is your position as soon as its close settles; an exit waits for you to withdraw it.
rules.6: Fees: 0.1 % in and 0.1 % out, taken in the token. They become the platform's hedge position.
rules.7: Issuer controls. The issuer of a stock token can pause it. Not available to persons in the United States.

h.title: Daily closes
h.intro: The pool settles once each trading day, on the official close. Every close goes on-chain with the sha256 of its price evidence, can be disputed for 6 hours while a second server re-checks it, and then settles. Press Check on any day to hash the evidence yourself.
h.waitingNote: The bell has rung; the close goes on-chain once Yahoo and Nasdaq agree (Yahoo alone after two hours) and Chainlink is within 1%.
h.skippedNote: No usable close that day: nothing moved, and its requests were filled on day {day}.
h.nasdaqSameRange: Nasdaq differed slightly; the evidence records both
h.nasdaqNone: Nasdaq had not published within two hours: Yahoo used alone (recorded in the evidence)
